notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded Unsubscribe Object Class Attributes implementation to both official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador declarations exported by the Requirements Lab for §5.9. It verifies each signature, declared exception set, adapter symbol, and real Catch2 selectors. The focused filesystem-report case verifies that an invalid attribute-set invocation appends nothing, an accepted attribute-set invocation emits ObjectClassHandle type 36 and AttributeHandleSet type 1, and the accepted whole-class overload retains the second supplied-argument slot as Null type 34. Advisory and scope/relevance delivery matrices, public MOM delivery, timestamped behavior, save/restore, DDM, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, validation, and conformance remain outside this slice.
